company_description:
Halden Pay is a fintech in the financial-services industry, offering business accounts, foreign-exchange risk management and trade finance to exporters. Its engineering teams work across product areas including payments, risk, data platform and client experience.

The company’s stated values are **Together, Ownership and Pace**: sharing information and supporting colleagues across teams, taking responsibility and learning from mistakes, and reducing unnecessary complexity to move quickly for clients. Halden Pay promotes career development through clear career paths, an annual learning budget and mentoring in every department.

Most offices use a hybrid model, with three days a week in the office. The company also describes team events and regular get-togethers across its roughly 40 offices as ways to build connections. Employee feedback characterises the culture as commercially driven, with friendly colleagues, though onboarding and training experiences may vary between teams. Culture ratings in the supplied results are around 3.3–3.4 out of 5.

results.title: Halden Pay | Careers
results.content:
Growth and recognition
We offer clear career paths, a yearly learning budget and a mentoring programme in every department.
Our values: Together, Ownership, Pace
Together - we share context openly and help each other across teams.
Ownership - when something goes wrong we own it, fix it and learn from it.
Pace - we cut unnecessary complexity so we can move quickly for our clients.
How we work
Most of our offices work hybrid: people spend three days a week together in the office and the rest wherever suits them. Our engineering teams are organised in product areas: payments, risk, data platform and client experience. Team events and regular get-togethers are part of how we build connections across about 40 offices.
